verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agentic-commerce identity and payments layer that supports agentic checkout, so tracking orders after purchase is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows an order-status or shipment-tracking API or MCP tool. The closest capabilities are token introspection (whether a token is usable and its remaining balance) and wallet balance with pending charges, which report payment state rather than the status or tracking of an order.
